steps.title: Enter protocol parameters
steps.instruction: Open the Opentrons OT‑2 Run App and input the required protocol parameters for the Barcoding run.

steps.title: Download protocol file
steps.instruction: Download the generated protocol file from the Opentrons interface.

steps.title: Upload protocol to OT‑App
steps.instruction: Upload the downloaded protocol file into the OT‑2 Run App.

steps.title: Set up deck according to map
steps.instruction: Arrange the deck exactly as shown in the deck map: place the Opentrons 96‑filter tip rack (20 µL tips), the ThermoFisher Scientific 96‑well PCR plate (200 µL, catalog AB‑0800 or 4483352) containing the sample plate from Parts 1 & 2, and the IonCode 96‑well plate for barcode adapters. Ensure the P20 multi‑channel electronic pipette is mounted.

steps.title: Calibrate labware and pipette
steps.instruction: Run the calibration routine in the OT‑2 App to calibrate the tip rack, both 96‑well plates, and the P20 multi‑channel pipette.

steps.title: Transfer IonCode barcode adapter
steps.instruction: Using the robot, transfer exactly 1 µL of IonCode Barcode Adapter from each well of the sample plate (generated in Parts 1 & 2) to the corresponding well of the IonCode 96‑well plate (one‑to‑one transfer).

steps.title: Execute protocol
steps.instruction: Press “Run” in the OT‑2 App to start the automated barcoding protocol.
